Container.Name: Snappy Plan
Container.Overview: Self-hosted Kanban task planning with boards, initiatives, and user accounts.
Container.Description: Snappy Plan is a self-hosted task planning application. Create a PostgreSQL database and connect both containers to the Unraid proxynet network. The first-run Launch page applies the schema and then guides you through administrator setup. Back up the database regularly before upgrading.

Config.Name: Secure session cookies
Config.Description: Keep true when accessing through HTTPS. Set false only for HTTP on a trusted LAN.

Config.Name: Launch setup key
Config.Description: Required one-time setup authorization. Use at least 32 random characters; it also authorizes initial administrator creation.

Config.Name: Persistent application configuration
Config.Description: Stores the PostgreSQL connection settings used after restarts. Protect this folder as it contains the database password.
